sanskrit: ahaṃ cānye ca rājāno yac ca tat kṣatramaṇḍalam gāṇḍīvāgniṃ pravekṣyāma iti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
english: I and the other kings and all the circle of warriors shall enter the fire of Gāṇḍīva — of this I have no doubt.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇa uvāca upasthitavināśeyaṃ nūnam adya vasuṃdharā tathā hi me vacaḥ karṇa nopaiti hṛdayaṃ tava
english: Kṛṣṇa said: The earth must surely be facing destruction today, for my words, O Karṇa, do not reach your heart.

sanskrit: sarveṣāṃ tāta bhūtānāṃ vināśe samupasthite anayo nayasaṃkāśo hṛdayān nāpasarpati
english: When destruction is at hand for all creatures, O dear one, what looks like wise counsel does not depart from the hearts of men — it is wrongdoing disguised as policy.

sanskrit: karṇa uvāca api tvā kṛṣṇa paśyāma jīvanto 'smān mahāraṇāt samuttīrṇā mahābāho vīrakṣayavināśanāt
english: Karṇa said: May we see you again, O Kṛṣṇa, having survived this great battle, O mighty-armed one, having crossed through the destruction and ruin of heroes.

sanskrit: atha vā saṃgamaḥ kṛṣṇa svarge no bhavitā dhruvam tatredānīṃ sameṣyāmaḥ punaḥ sārdhaṃ tvayānagha
english: Or else, O Kṛṣṇa, our reunion shall surely be in heaven — there we shall meet again, together with you, O sinless one.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca ity uktvā mādhavaṃ karṇaḥ pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam visarjitaḥ keśavena rathopasthād avātarat
english: Sañjaya said: Having spoken thus to Mādhava and embraced him tightly, Karṇa, dismissed by Keśava, descended from the floor of the chariot.

sanskrit: tataḥ svaratham āsthāya jāmbūnadavibhūṣitam sahāsmābhir nivavṛte rādheyo dīnamānasaḥ
english: Then, mounting his own chariot adorned with gold, Rādheya returned with us, his heart despondent.

sanskrit: tataḥ śīghrataraṃ prāyāt keśavaḥ sahasātyakiḥ punar uccārayan vāṇīṃ yāhi yāhīti sārathim
english: Then Keśava drove away swiftly, together with Sātyaki, repeatedly calling out to his charioteer, "Go, go!"

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca asiddhānunaye kṛṣṇe kurubhyaḥ pāṇḍavān gate abhigamya pṛthāṃ kṣattā śanaiḥ śocann ivābravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: When Kṛṣṇa had departed from the Kurus to the Pāṇḍavas with his mission of conciliation unfulfilled, Vidura approached Pṛthā and spoke to her gently, as if grieving.

sanskrit: jānāsi me jīvaputre bhāvaṃ nityam anugrahe krośato na ca gṛhṇīte vacanaṃ me suyodhanaḥ
english: O you whose sons are living, you know my disposition, always devoted to your welfare — yet Suyodhana does not accept my words, though I cry out repeatedly.

sanskrit: upapanno hy asau rājā cedipāñcālakekayaiḥ bhīmārjunābhyāṃ kṛṣṇena yuyudhānayamair api
english: That king is supported by the Cedis, Pāñcālas, and Kekayas, by Bhīma and Arjuna, by Kṛṣṇa, Yuyudhāna, and the Yamas as well.

sanskrit: upaplavye niviṣṭo 'pi dharmam eva yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kāṅkṣate jñātisauhārdād balavān durbalo yathā
english: Even while encamped at Upaplavya, Yudhiṣṭhira — powerful as he is — desires only righteousness out of affection for his kinsmen, like a weak man.

sanskrit: rājā tu dhṛtarāṣṭro 'yaṃ vayovṛddho na śāmyati mattaḥ putramadenaiva vidharme pathi vartate
english: But this king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, though old in years, does not calm himself — intoxicated solely by pride in his son, he walks the path of unrighteousness.

sanskrit: jayadrathasya karṇasya tathā duḥśāsanasya ca saubalasya ca durbuddhyā mithobhedaḥ pravartate
english: Through the evil counsel of Jayadratha, Karṇa, Duḥśāsana, and Śakuni's son, mutual strife is being fanned.

sanskrit: adharmeṇa hi dharmiṣṭhaṃ hṛtaṃ vai rājyam īdṛśam yeṣāṃ teṣām ayaṃ dharmaḥ sānubandho bhaviṣyati
english: The kingdom has indeed been seized by unrighteous means from those who are most righteous — this very unrighteousness, with all its consequences, shall return upon those who took it.

sanskrit: hriyamāṇe balād dharme kurubhiḥ ko na saṃjvaret asāmnā keśave yāte samudyokṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
english: Who would not burn with indignation when righteousness is forcibly wrested away by the Kurus? With Keśava gone without conciliation, the Pāṇḍavas shall make ready for war.

sanskrit: tataḥ kurūṇām anayo bhavitā vīranāśanaḥ cintayan na labhe nidrām ahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca
english: Then the Kurus will meet with ruin and the slaughter of their heroes. Thinking of this, I find no sleep by day or by night.

sanskrit: śrutvā tu kuntī tad vākyam arthakāmena bhāṣitam aniṣṭanantī duḥkhārtā manasā vimamarśa ha
english: Kuntī, hearing those words spoken with genuine purpose, unwilling to accept what she did not desire, afflicted with grief, reflected deeply in her mind.

sanskrit: dhig astv arthaṃ yatkṛte 'yaṃ mahāñ jñātivadhe kṣayaḥ vartsyate suhṛdāṃ hy eṣāṃ yuddhe 'smin vai parābhavaḥ
english: Shame on wealth, for the sake of which this great destruction among kinsmen will occur — for in this war the defeat of these friends shall surely come to pass.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavāś cedipāñcālā yādavāś ca samāgatāḥ bhāratair yadi yotsyanti kiṃ nu duḥkham ataḥ param
english: If the Pāṇḍavas, the Cedis, the Pāñcālas, and the Yādavas, assembled together, fight against the Bhāratas, what sorrow could be greater than this?

sanskrit: paśye doṣaṃ dhruvaṃ yuddhe tathā yuddhe parābhavam adhanasya mṛtaṃ śreyo na hi jñātikṣaye jayaḥ
english: I see only certain calamity in this war, and defeat in this war as well. Death is better than poverty, for victory is no victory when it comes through the slaughter of kinsmen.

sanskrit: pitāmahaḥ śāṃtanava ācāryaś ca yudhāṃ patiḥ karṇaś ca dhārtarāṣṭrārthaṃ vardhayanti bhayaṃ mama
english: Bhīṣma the son of Śāntanu, the preceptor who is lord of warriors, and Karṇa — all fighting for the sake of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son — increase my fear.

sanskrit: nācāryaḥ kāmavāñ śiṣyair droṇo yudhyeta jātu cit pāṇḍaveṣu kathaṃ hārdaṃ kuryān na ca pitāmahaḥ
english: Surely teacher Droṇa, who has no desire for personal gain, would never willingly fight against his pupils — and how could the grandsire Bhīṣma not feel affection for the Pāṇḍavas?

sanskrit: ayaṃ tv eko vṛthādṛṣṭir dhārtarāṣṭrasya durmateḥ mohānuvartī satataṃ pāpo dveṣṭi ca pāṇḍavān
english: But this one alone — evil, holding perverse views, always following delusion, the wicked man who serves the evil-minded Dhārtarāṣṭra — constantly hates the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: mahaty anarthe nirbandhī balavāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ karṇaḥ sadā pāṇḍavānāṃ tan me dahati sāṃpratam
english: Karṇa is particularly insistent on great calamity, and he is especially powerful; he always opposes the Pāṇḍavas — this burns me now.

sanskrit: āśaṃse tv adya karṇasya mano 'haṃ pāṇḍavān prati prasādayitum āsādya darśayantī yathātatham
english: But today I hope to appease Karṇa's mind toward the Pāṇḍavas, by approaching him and showing him the truth of the matter.

sanskrit: toṣito bhagavān yatra durvāsā me varaṃ dadau āhvānaṃ devasaṃyuktaṃ vasantyāḥ pitṛveśmani
english: When I had pleased the revered Durvāsas, he gave me a boon — a divine invocation connected with the gods, while I was living in my father's house.

sanskrit: sāham antaḥpure rājñaḥ kuntibhojapuraskṛtā cintayantī bahuvidhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā
english: I was then in the inner quarters of king Kuntibhoja's palace, my heart aching, thinking in many ways.

sanskrit: balābalaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇasya ca vāgbalam strībhāvād bālabhāvāc ca cintayantī punaḥ punaḥ
english: I kept thinking again and again about the strength and weakness of the mantras, about the power of a brahmin's word, and about the weaknesses of a woman and a child.

sanskrit: dhātryā viśrabdhayā guptā sakhījanavṛtā tadā doṣaṃ pariharantī ca pituś cāritrarakṣiṇī
english: Protected then by a trusted nurse, surrounded by my circle of companions, guarding against transgression, and preserving my father's honor.

sanskrit: kathaṃ nu sukṛtaṃ me syān nāparādhavatī katham bhaveyam iti saṃcintya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ namasya ca
english: Thinking "How may I do what is right? How may I be without guilt?" and having bowed to that brahmin,

sanskrit: kautūhalāt tu taṃ labdhvā bāliśyād ācaraṃ tadā kanyā satī devam arkam āsādayam ahaṃ tataḥ
english: Out of curiosity upon receiving it, and acting foolishly out of childishness, I, a chaste girl, then invoked the god Sūrya.

sanskrit: yo 'sau kānīnagarbho me putravat parivartitaḥ kasmān na kuryād vacanaṃ pathyaṃ bhrātṛhitaṃ tathā
english: He who was born of me before wedlock and has been treated as a son — why would he not heed words that are wholesome and beneficial to his brothers?

sanskrit: iti kuntī viniścitya kāryaṃ niścitam uttamam kāryārtham abhiniryāya yayau bhāgīrathīṃ prati
english: Having thus resolved upon this as the highest and most certain course of action, Kuntī set out on her errand and went to the Bhāgīrathī river.

sanskrit: ātmajasya tatas tasya ghṛṇinaḥ satyasaṅginaḥ gaṅgātīre pṛthāśṛṇvad upādhyayananisvanam
english: On the bank of the Gaṅgā, Pṛthā then heard the sound of her own son's recitation — that compassionate and truth-devoted man.

sanskrit: prāṅmukhasyordhvabāhoḥ sā paryatiṣṭhata pṛṣṭhataḥ japyāvasānaṃ kāryārthaṃ pratīkṣantī tapasvinī
english: That ascetic woman stood behind him, who faced east with upraised arms, waiting for the end of his silent recitation so she could accomplish her purpose.

sanskrit: atiṣṭhat sūryatāpārtā karṇasyottaravāsasi kauravyapatnī vārṣṇeyī padmamāleva śuṣyatī
english: She stood on the northern robe of Karṇa, scorched by the sun, the wife of a Kaurava and daughter of the Vṛṣṇis, withering like a garland of lotuses.

sanskrit: ā pṛṣṭhatāpāj japtvā sa parivṛtya yatavrataḥ dṛṣṭvā kuntīm upātiṣṭhad abhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ yathānyāyaṃ mahātejā mānī dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
english: Having recited until his back too was scorched by the sun, that disciplined man turned around; seeing Kuntī, the great-spirited and honorable Karṇa, best among upholders of righteousness, approached and greeted her with joined palms as propriety required.

sanskrit: karṇa uvāca rādheyo 'ham ādhirathiḥ karṇas tvām abhivādaye prāptā kimarthaṃ bhavatī brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
english: Karṇa said: I am Karṇa, son of Rādhā, son of Adhiratha — I salute you. What brings you here, noble lady? Tell me, what may I do for you?

sanskrit: kunty uvāca kaunteyas tvaṃ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā nāsi sūtakule jātaḥ karṇa tad viddhi me vacaḥ
english: Kuntī said: You are a son of Kuntī, not of Rādhā; Adhiratha is not your father. You were not born in a sūta family, O Karṇa — know this from my words.

sanskrit: kānīnas tvaṃ mayā jātaḥ pūrvajaḥ kukṣiṇā dhṛtaḥ kuntibhojasya bhavane pārthas tvam asi putraka
english: You were born of me before my marriage, carried in my womb as my firstborn, in the house of Kuntibhoja — you are a son of Pṛthā, dear child.

sanskrit: prakāśakarmā tapano yo 'yaṃ devo virocanaḥ ajījanat tvāṃ mayy eṣa karṇa śastrabhṛtāṃ varam
english: This god who performs brilliant deeds, the sun, who illumines all — he begot you in me, O Karṇa, best among bearers of weapons.

sanskrit: kuṇḍalī baddhakavaco devagarbhaḥ śriyā vṛtaḥ jātas tvam asi durdharṣa mayā putra pitur gṛhe
english: Born wearing earrings, with armor fastened on, conceived of a god, and endowed with splendor, you, O invincible one, were born of me, my son, in my father's house.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ bhrātṝn asaṃbuddhvā mohād yad upasevase dhārtarāṣṭrān na tad yuktaṃ tvayi putra viśeṣataḥ
english: That you, failing to recognize your brothers, serve the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra out of delusion — that is not fitting for you, my son, especially not for you.

sanskrit: etad dharmaphalaṃ putra narāṇāṃ dharmaniścaye yat tuṣyanty asya pitaro mātā cāpy ekadarśinī
english: This is the fruit of righteousness for men when righteousness is their aim, O son — that his fathers are pleased, and his mother who shares the same vision.

sanskrit: arjunena arjitāṃ pūrvaṃ hṛtāṃ lobhād asādhubhiḥ ācchidya dhārtarāṣṭrebhyo bhuṅkṣva yaudhiṣṭhirīṃ śriyam
english: Seize back from the Dhārtarāṣṭras the royal glory of Yudhiṣṭhira, which was earned by Arjuna and taken by wicked men out of greed, and enjoy it.

sanskrit: adya paśyantu kuravaḥ karṇārjunasamāgamam saubhrātreṇa tad ālakṣya saṃnamantām asādhavaḥ
english: Today let the Kurus behold the union of Karṇa and Arjuna; witnessing that brotherhood, let the wicked ones bow their heads.

sanskrit: karṇārjunau vai bhavatāṃ yathā rāmajanārdanau asādhyaṃ kiṃ nu loke syād yuvayoḥ sahitātmanoḥ
english: If Karṇa and Arjuna were as Rāma and Janārdana together, what in the world would be unachievable for you two with united hearts?

sanskrit: karṇa śobhiṣyase nūnaṃ pañcabhir bhrātṛbhir vṛtaḥ vedaiḥ parivṛto brahmā yathā vedāṅgapañcamaiḥ
english: O Karṇa, you will surely shine, surrounded by five brothers, as Brahmā is surrounded by the Vedas together with the five Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit: upapanno guṇaiḥ śreṣṭho jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭheṣu bandhuṣu sūtaputreti mā śabdaḥ pārthas tvam asi vīryavān
english: Endowed with the finest qualities, the eldest among the most excellent kinsmen — let the epithet "son of a charioteer" not be spoken; you are a son of Pṛthā, O valiant one.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ sūryān niścaritāṃ karṇaḥ śuśrāva bhāratīm duratyayāṃ praṇayinīṃ pitṛvad bhāskareritām
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Karṇa heard words issuing from the sun — irresistible, affectionate, urging him as a father would, sent by Bhāskara.

sanskrit: satyam āha pṛthā vākyaṃ karṇa mātṛvacaḥ kuru śreyas te syān naravyāghra sarvam ācaratas tathā
english: Pṛthā speaks the truth, O Karṇa — heed your mother's words. It shall be for your good, O tiger among men, if you act accordingly in everything.

sanskrit: evam uktasya mātrā ca svayaṃ pitrā ca bhānunā cacāla naiva karṇasya matiḥ satyadhṛtes tadā
english: Although thus addressed by his mother and by the sun himself, his father, the resolve of Karṇa, steadfast in truth, did not waver even then.

sanskrit: karṇa uvāca na te na śraddadhe vākyaṃ kṣatriye bhāṣitaṃ tvayā dharmadvāraṃ mamaitat syān niyogakaraṇaṃ tava
english: Karṇa said: I do not disbelieve the words you, O kṣatriya lady, have spoken to me — this your commission may be the gate of righteousness for me.

sanskrit: akaron mayi yat pāpaṃ bhavatī sumahātyayam avakīrṇo 'smi te tena tad yaśaḥkīrtināśanam
english: The great transgression you committed against me — by that act you have cast me out, and it destroyed my fame and reputation.

sanskrit: ahaṃ ca kṣatriyaḥ jāto na prāptaḥ kṣatrasatkriyām tvatkṛte kiṃ nu pāpīyaḥ śatruḥ kuryān mamāhitam
english: I was born a kṣatriya yet did not attain the rites proper to a kṣatriya — because of you. What worse harm could an enemy do to me?

sanskrit: kriyākāle tv anukrośam akṛtvā tvam imaṃ mama hīnasaṃskārasamayam adya māṃ samacūcudaḥ
english: Not showing compassion for me at the time of the rites, you left me then in a state deprived of proper sacraments — and now today you urge me.

sanskrit: na vai mama hitaṃ pūrvaṃ mātṛvac ceṣṭitaṃ tvayā sā māṃ saṃbodhayasy adya kevalātmahitaiṣiṇī
english: You did not act toward me before as a mother concerned with my welfare — and now you counsel me, seeking only your own benefit.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇena sahitāt ko vai na vyatheta dhanaṃjayāt ko 'dya bhītaṃ na māṃ vidyāt pārthānāṃ samitiṃ gatam
english: Who would not tremble before Dhanaṃjaya, who is united with Kṛṣṇa? Who would not know me today as afraid, if I went over to the assembly of the Pārthas?

sanskrit: abhrātā viditaḥ pūrvaṃ yuddhakāle prakāśitaḥ pāṇḍavān yadi gacchāmi kiṃ māṃ kṣatraṃ vadiṣyati
english: Unknown as a brother before, revealed only at the time of war — if I now go to the Pāṇḍavas, what will the kṣatriyas say of me?

sanskrit: sarvakāmaiḥ saṃvibhaktaḥ pūjitaś ca sadā bhṛśam ahaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ kuryāṃ tad aphalaṃ katham
english: I have been given every pleasure and been constantly and greatly honored by the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra — how can I render their efforts fruitless?

sanskrit: upanahya parair vairaṃ ye māṃ nityam upāsate namaskurvanti ca sadā vasavo vāsavaṃ yathā
english: Those who have incurred the enmity of others on my account, who always attend upon me and ever bow to me as the Vasus bow to Indra —

sanskrit: mama prāṇena ye śatrūñ śaktāḥ pratisamāsitum manyante 'dya kathaṃ teṣām ahaṃ bhindyāṃ manoratham
english: Those who believe themselves able, through my life's effort, to withstand their enemies — how today could I shatter their heart's desire?

sanskrit: mayā plavena saṃgrāmaṃ titīrṣanti duratyayam apāre pārakāmā ye tyajeyaṃ tān ahaṃ katham
english: Those who wish to cross the impassable battle with me as their boat, who desire the other shore of the shoreless sea — how could I abandon them?

sanskrit: ayaṃ hi kālaḥ saṃprāpto dhārtarāṣṭropajīvinām nirveṣṭavyaṃ mayā tatra prāṇān aparirakṣatā
english: For this is the time that has come for those who live in dependence on Dhārtarāṣṭra — I must discharge my debt there, without sparing my life.

sanskrit: kṛtārthāḥ subhṛtā ye hi kṛtyakāla upasthite anavekṣya kṛtaṃ pāpā vikurvanty anavasthitāḥ
english: Those who, having been well maintained and their purposes fulfilled, act treacherously when the time of need arrives, disregarding what was done for them — they are wicked and unstable.

sanskrit: rājakilbiṣiṇāṃ teṣāṃ bhartṛpiṇḍāpahāriṇām naivāyaṃ na paro loko vidyate pāpakarmaṇām
english: For those sinful men who are guilty of betraying their king and who steal the master's bread — neither this world nor the next exists.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇām arthe yotsyāmi te sutaiḥ balaṃ ca śaktiṃ cāsthāya na vai tvayy anṛtaṃ vade
english: I shall fight for the sake of the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra against your sons, employing all my strength and power — truly I do not speak falsely to you.

sanskrit: ānṛśaṃsyam atho vṛttaṃ rakṣan satpuruṣocitam ato 'rthakaram apy etan na karomy adya te vacaḥ
english: Protecting compassion and the conduct befitting an honorable man, even though your proposal would benefit me, I shall not follow your words today.

sanskrit: na tu te 'yaṃ samārambho mayi mogho bhaviṣyati vadhyān viṣahyān saṃgrāme na haniṣyāmi te sutān yudhiṣṭhiraṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca yamau caivārjunād ṛte
english: Yet your undertaking shall not be in vain with respect to me — in battle I shall not slay your sons who are worthy of being slain and who can be defeated: Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma, and the twins — save only for Arjuna.

sanskrit: arjunena samaṃ yuddhaṃ mama yaudhiṣṭhire bale arjunaṃ hi nihatyājau saṃprāptaṃ syāt phalaṃ mayā yaśasā cāpi yujyeyaṃ nihataḥ savyasācinā
english: My combat with Arjuna in the army of Yudhiṣṭhira will be even — for by slaying Arjuna in battle the goal shall be achieved by me, and I shall also be united with glory even if slain by Savyasācin.

sanskrit: na te jātu naśiṣyanti putrāḥ pañca yaśasvini nirarjunāḥ sakarṇā vā sārjunā vā hate mayi
english: Your five sons, O glorious lady, shall never perish — whether without Arjuna but with Karṇa alive, or with Arjuna but with me slain.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca iti karṇavacaḥ śrutvā kuntī duḥkhāt pravepatī uvāca putram āśliṣya karṇaṃ dhairyād akampitam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Hearing Karṇa's words, Kuntī trembled with grief; she embraced her son Karṇa, who remained unshaken in his steadfastness, and spoke.

sanskrit: evaṃ vai bhāvyam etena kṣayaṃ yāsyanti kauravāḥ yathā tvaṃ bhāṣase karṇa daivaṃ tu balavattaram
english: "So it must be — through this the Kurus shall meet their destruction. As you speak, O Karṇa, fate is the more powerful."

sanskrit: tvayā caturṇāṃ bhrātṝṇām abhayaṃ śatrukarśana dattaṃ tat pratijānīhi saṃgarapratimocanam
english: "The safety you have granted to my four sons, O vanquisher of foes — pledge that promise, the release from battle."

sanskrit: anāmayaṃ svasti ceti pṛthātho karṇam abravīt tāṃ karṇo 'bhyavadat prītas tatas tau jagmatuḥ pṛthak
english: "Be well, be safe," said Pṛthā to Karṇa; Karṇa responded to her with affection, and then the two departed separately.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca āgamya hāstinapurād upaplavyam ariṃdamaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ yathāvṛttaṃ keśavaḥ sarvam uktavān
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having come from Hāstinapura to Upaplavya, the subduer of enemies, Keśava, told the Pāṇḍavas everything that had occurred.

sanskrit: saṃbhāṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ mantrayitvā punaḥ punaḥ svam evāvasathaṃ śaurir viśrāmārthaṃ jagāma ha
english: Having conversed for a long time and deliberated again and again, Śauri went to his own quarters to rest.

sanskrit: visṛjya sarvān nṛpatīn virāṭapramukhāṃs tadā pāṇḍavā bhrātaraḥ pañca bhānāv astaṃgate sati
english: Having dismissed all the kings headed by Virāṭa, the five Pāṇḍava brothers, when the sun had set,

sanskrit: saṃdhyām upāsya dhyāyantas tam eva gatamānasāḥ ānāyya kṛṣṇaṃ dāśārhaṃ punar mantram amantrayan
english: having performed the twilight prayer and meditating, their minds fixed on that same matter, brought Kṛṣṇa of the Dāśārha clan once more and deliberated in counsel again.
